tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, names and spoken caption words.

tokens.name: soon
tokens.usage: Caption words not yet spoken.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: The second line of a lower third.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: White rounded panels and caption pills over footage.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rose. The one italic word in a headline. Also the middle card.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Gold sparkle beside a title or a name. Never on text.

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Pastel page gradient, top-left (160deg).

tokens.name: page-mid
tokens.usage: Pastel page gradient, middle.

tokens.name: page-bottom
tokens.usage: Pastel page gradient, bottom-right.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Card colour.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Card colour.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Card colour.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Card colour, for a fourth card.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Left and right edge of panels on a 1080-wide frame.

tokens.name: title-top
tokens.usage: Top of the title panel over footage.

tokens.name: caption-top
tokens.usage: Top of the caption pill over footage (1300px on a pastel page).

tokens.name: lower-third-top
tokens.usage: Top of the name panel: on the chest, above the caption pill.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Keep all text at least this far from every frame edge.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Title and name panels.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Pastel cards.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The small speaker frame, with an 8px white border.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Caption pills.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: anything arriving. GSAP: power3.out.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits. GSAP: power2.in.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: The sparkle only: it pops in with a small overshoot.

tokens.name: rise
tokens.usage: Distance a word, panel or pill rises as it fades in. No blur.

tokens.name: word-stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between headline words as they arrive.

tokens.name: card-stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between cards as they rise and settle into their tilt.

tokens.name: enter
tokens.usage: Words 0.4 s, panels 0.5 s, cards 0.6 s.

tokens.name: exit
tokens.usage: About half an entrance. Caption pills fade in 0.12 s.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Minimum time a line stays still to be read.
